nameOrigin: small mammal with a long body

pokedexEntries.di: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

pokedexEntries.prl: It sends signals to others by carving odd patterns in frost-covered trees and ice.

pokedexEntries.pt: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

pokedexEntries.bw: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: They communicate by clawing signs in boulders and work together to surround enemies.

pokedexEntries.x: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

pokedexEntries.or: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

pokedexEntries.y: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

pokedexEntries.as: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

pokedexEntries.su: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

pokedexEntries.mo: They dwell in cold places. This Pokémon’s main food source in Alola is Vulpix and Sandshrew, which they carefully divide among their group.

pokedexEntries.us: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.

pokedexEntries.um: Thanks to its increased intelligence, scrapping over food is a thing of the past. A scratch from its claws will give you a case of frostbite!

pokedexEntries.sw: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

pokedexEntries.sh: With its claws, it leaves behind signs for its friends to find. The number of distinct signs is said to be over 500.

pokedexEntries.bd: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

pokedexEntries.shp: It sends signals to others of its kind by carving odd patterns on trees and ice.

pokedexEntries.la: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

pokedexEntries.sc: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.
